description: scriptconv's Arbtok backend (Phonemizer.ARBTOK), primarily an Arabic tokenizer/phonemizer (see arbtok-over-o2i-for-arabic in the org wiki) that also fell through to producing English IPA-ish output in this venv: get_ipa('hello','en-US')=='hiljuː' verified on 3 en-US samples. Registered as-is per this PR's literal working-matrix rule; quality/appropriateness of this backend for English is unverified and likely poor (no Arabic dataset exists in this arena's g2p league yet to test its intended use).
notes: Verified working for en-US in the shared venv. pt-PT SKIPPED: timed out (>25s, likely a lazy model/resource load) during this probe - not registered for pt-PT pending a longer-timeout re-check, to avoid asserting a language claim that wasn't actually observed to succeed.
